summary.text: Amy Galey is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 25, covering Alamance and Randolph counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Southey Blanton.
An attorney, she serves as Senate Majority Whip.

paragraphs.text: Galey graduated from Western Alamance High School in 1985, received a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1989 and earned a law degree from the University of North Carolina in 1994, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as attorney.
Galey has served in the Senate since 2021, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly's website lists her as Senate Majority Whip.
She chairs the Appropriations on Health and Human Services and Health Care committees and co-chairs the Joint Legislative Administrative Procedure Oversight Committee.
The Republican primary for her seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
